snippet.title: ASK TITO: How His Father Inspired His Love of the Blues
snippet.description:
In 2021, Tito Jackson released his single “Love One Another” and his second solo album, the critically acclaimed blues record UNDER YOUR SPELL. To mark the occasion, Tito sat down for ASK TITO, a series of 15 short videos in which he answered questions and shared personal stories, memories and reflections in his own words.

UNDER YOUR SPELL showcased Tito’s talents as a singer, songwriter, guitarist, producer and arranger. The album featured an extraordinary group of special guests, including Stevie Wonder, George Benson, Joe Bonamassa, Grady Champion, Marlon Jackson, Claudette King, Eddie Levert of The O’Jays, Kenny Neal, Steven Powell and Bobby Rush.

Both “Love One Another” and UNDER YOUR SPELL were initially released in 2021 but were later withdrawn, with the intention of bringing them back at a more suitable time. They will now be released posthumously, at a moment that feels right.

Revisit the complete ASK TITO series, we can once again hear Tito speak, laugh and share his thoughts in his own words. Through these special videos, his warmth, wisdom, humour and deep love for music continue to live on.
